description: Dept. of Local Government- Eastern Province Elected and declared New Chairman of Manmunaipatty Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the election and declaration of a new Chairman for Manmunai Pattu Pradeshiya Sabha under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with election results and declarations for local government authorities, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) as it involves the electoral process and declaration of elected officials for local government bodies.
